statements.update: update SS10USER set USERPWD=#Userpwd#,USERKET=#Userket# where USERID = #Userid#
statements.select: select rtrim(S.USERID) as USERID,rtrim(S.USERTYPE) as USERTYPE ,rtrim(S.USERNAMA) as USERNAMA,rtrim(S.USERNIP) as USERNIP,rtrim(S.USERHP) as USERHP ,rtrim(S.USEREMAIL) as USEREMAIL,rtrim(S.USERURAIAN) as USERURAIAN ,rtrim(S.USERBLOCK) as USERBLOCK,rtrim(S.USERPWD) as USERPWD,S.USERNO ,S.USERSTATUS,rtrim(S.USERKET) as USERKET ,rtrim(S.KDPEMDA) as KDPEMDA,rtrim(P.NMPEMDA) as NMPEMDA ,S.STATUS,D.NMSTATUS as STATUSNAME,D.STATUSICON ,rtrim(isnull(S.LAST_BY,'')) as LAST_BY,S.LAST_DATE from SS10USER S left outer join DMPEMDA P on S.KDPEMDA=P.KDPEMDA left outer join DMSTATUS D on S.STATUS=D.IDSTATUS
where 1=1 and S.KDPEMDA = #Kdpemda# order by S.USERID
where 1=1 and (S.KDPEMDA = #Kdpemda# or isnull(#Kdpemda#,'')='' ) order by S.USERID
where 1=1 and S.USERID not in (select USERID from SS10USERAPP where IDAPP=#Idapp#) and S.KDPEMDA=#Kdpemda# order by S.USERID
where 1=1 and S.USERID not in (select USERID from SS10USERAPP where IDAPP=#Idapp#) order by S.USERID
where 1=1 and S.USERID not in (select USERID from SIPD01DM.dbo.DMUSER where KDPEMDA=#Kdpemda#) order by S.USERID
where 1=1 and S.USERID not in (select USERID from SIPD01DM.dbo.DM103USER where IDUNIT=#Idunit#) order by S.USERID

select #Idapp# as IDAPP,rtrim(S.USERID) as USERID,rtrim(S.USERPWD) as USERPWD ,rtrim(S.USERTYPE) as USERTYPE,rtrim(S.USERNAMA) as USERNAMA,rtrim(S.USERKET) as USERKET ,rtrim(S.USERBLOCK) as USERBLOCK,rtrim(S.USERNIP) as USERNIP,rtrim(S.USERHP) as USERHP ,rtrim(S.USEREMAIL) as USEREMAIL,S.USERNO ,rtrim(S.USERURAIAN) as USERURAIAN,S.USERSTATUS ,rtrim(S.KDPEMDA) as KDPEMDA,rtrim(P.NMPEMDA) as NMPEMDA ,S.STATUS,D.NMSTATUS as STATUSNAME,D.STATUSICON ,rtrim(isnull(S.LAST_BY,'')) as LAST_BY,S.LAST_DATE from SS10USER S left outer join DMPEMDA P on S.KDPEMDA=P.KDPEMDA left outer join DMSTATUS D on S.STATUS=D.IDSTATUS where 1=1 and S.USERID = #Userid#

select #Idapp# as IDAPP,rtrim(S.USERID) as USERID,rtrim(S.USERPWD) as USERPWD ,rtrim(S.USERTYPE) as USERTYPE,rtrim(S.USERNAMA) as USERNAMA,rtrim(S.USERKET) as USERKET ,rtrim(S.USERBLOCK) as USERBLOCK,rtrim(S.USERNIP) as USERNIP,rtrim(S.USERHP) as USERHP ,rtrim(S.USEREMAIL) as USEREMAIL,S.USERNO ,rtrim(S.USERURAIAN) as USERURAIAN,S.USERSTATUS ,rtrim(S.KDPEMDA) as KDPEMDA,rtrim(P.NMPEMDA) as NMPEMDA ,S.STATUS,D.NMSTATUS as STATUSNAME,D.STATUSICON ,rtrim(isnull(S.LAST_BY,'')) as LAST_BY,S.LAST_DATE from SS10USER S left outer join DMPEMDA P on S.KDPEMDA=P.KDPEMDA left outer join DMSTATUS D on S.STATUS=D.IDSTATUS where S.USERID = #Userid# and (isnull(#Idapp#,'')='' or S.USERID in (select USERID from SS10USERAPP where IDAPP=#Idapp#))
